current_grouping: Subpart H — Electrical Wiring Interconnection System

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H — Electrical Wiring Interconnection System
versions.text: (a) EWIS associated with any powerplant must be designed and installed so that the failure of an EWIS component will not prevent the continued safe operation of the remaining powerplants or require immediate action by any crew member for continued safe operation, in accordance with the requirements of CS 25.903(b). (b) Design precautions must be taken to minimise hazards to the aeroplane due to EWIS damage in the event of a powerplant rotor failure or of a fire originating within the powerplant, which burns through the powerplant case, in accordance with the requirements of CS 25.903(d)(1).
